segments.mature: Reviewers who describe themselves as over 40 or mature, including several in their 40s, 50s and 60s, report visible firming and fewer fine lines with consistent use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report the serum leaves skin hydrated, plumper and less dull, and describe it as working well on dry-to-combination skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one who reports redness alongside fine lines, say the serum helped without irritation, and several appreciate that it is free of artificial fragrance, though the scent itself divides opinion.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it absorbs well and leaves skin hydrated without heaviness.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on fine lines and firmness widely report visibly firmer, plumper, more lifted skin within one to a few weeks of nightly or twice-daily use, though a few say results were modest or not yet noticeable after a month.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report the serum hydrates and adds glow, with several describing a plumping effect.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention redness or irritated skin report the serum soothed it without stinging, including one who says it instantly soothed her usually red, irritated skin.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers report the serum broke them out, made their skin oily, or turned their face red shortly after starting it, while most other reviewers report no breakouts and describe it as compatible with acne-prone skin.
